evals.name: edited-ticketing-output
evals.prompt: Ticketing has a reviewed model revision. Its generated handler contains an emergency manual change. Render reports a collision. How can we deliver without losing the fix?
evals.expected_output: No destructive publication; an owned implementation and a target check for the ticket outcome.
assertions: Preserves the edited output and does not force overwrite.
Previews the intended scope, distinguishes generated files from supported application seams, and rerenders only after reconciliation.
Requires the ticket outcome on the running target rather than accepting render success.
